description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Reworked the gyroscope: look control now uses a relative delta stream, with separate horizontal/vertical sensitivity, per-axis inversion, moving-average smoothing and a dead zone, and axis mapping that follows screen rotation; the touch pad gained slide- and distance-acceleration toggles, and touch coordinates are passed through as floats so slow look movements no longer stutter.
2. External mouse/keyboard improvements: a pointer-capture watchdog retries silent loss and degrades to hover-delta look on persistent failure, and a mouse-button state machine deduplicates right/middle button events that used to fire twice; the right menu's mouse page gained customizable shortcut keys for pointer capture and IME switching, with modifier-key combinations.
3. Added a game-session foreground service that keeps the process priority up while Minecraft is running, reducing the chance of the game being killed in the background.
4. Forced resolution moved into the in-game menu: the toggle applies immediately and width/height can be edited live; coordinate conversion is now unified, fixing cursor offset and look-delta drift under forced resolution.
5. The game now requests the highest refresh-rate mode at the same resolution, removing the 60fps lock on some devices, with a "request max refresh rate" toggle in the debug section of the right menu.
6. Declared game_mode_config to opt into the Android 12+ system game mode, refusing system downscaling and frame-rate overrides.
7. The file browser gained regular file management: create/rename/delete/copy/cut/paste, sort order and hidden-file toggles, long-press actions and batch operations.
8. Xms and Xmx are decoupled, letting the heap grow on demand instead of committing all physical memory up front.
9. Fixed quick input and the "send text" button doing nothing on 26.3 - text is now committed through the SDL text-input channel.
10. Fixed the view jumping when holding to look while opening/closing in-game screens, paired key/char resend breaking non-Cleanroom instances, remote mod info lost after search/filter refresh, mod favorites failing to open details on cold start, duplicated title animations on the account/version pages, and more.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.陀螺仪重构：转视角改相对增量流，新增横向/纵向灵敏度与分轴反转、滑动窗口平均与死区过滤，轴映射随屏幕旋转自适应；触摸板新增滑动加速与距离加速开关，触摸坐标浮点透传消除慢速转视角顿挫
2.外置键鼠优化：指针捕获看门狗自动重试、失败降级为悬停差值转视角，鼠标键状态机去重根治右键/中键双触发；右菜单鼠标页新增指针捕获与输入法切换自定义快捷键，支持主键+修饰键组合
3.新增游戏会话前台服务保活，游戏运行期间保持进程优先级，降低切后台被系统回收的概率
4.强制分辨率迁移到游戏内菜单，开关即时生效、宽高可实时修改；坐标换算统一收敛，修复光标偏移与视角增量偏差
5.游戏请求同分辨率最高刷新率档位，解除部分设备 60fps 锁定，右菜单调试分类新增"请求最高刷新率"开关
6.声明 game_mode_config 接入 Android 12+ 系统游戏模式，拒绝系统降分辨率与帧率覆写干预
7.文件浏览器新增常规文件管理：新建/重命名/删除/复制/剪切/粘贴、排序方式与显示隐藏文件开关、长按操作菜单与批量操作
8.Xms 与 Xmx 解耦，堆按需增长，避免按峰值全量提交物理内存
9.修复 26.3 下快捷输入与"发送文本"按钮无效，文本改经 SDL 文本输入通道提交
10.修复按住拖动视角时开关游戏界面视角突跳、按键与字符成对补发误伤非 Cleanroom 实例、模组列表搜索后远程信息丢失、冷启动点击模组收藏无法跳转、账户/版本页标题动画重复触发等问题
